description: Per-user atomic facts + max_cleared_chapter from /adventures/clear responseBody.

script.source: if (doc['data.requestPath.keyword'].size() == 0) return; if (doc['data.requestPath.keyword'].value != '/adventures/clear') return; def src = params._source; if (src == null || src.data == null || src.data.responseBody == null) return; String s = String.valueOf(src.data.responseBody); int idx = s.indexOf('lastClearedChapter'); if (idx < 0) return; int colon = s.indexOf(':', idx); if (colon < 0) return; String after = s.substring(colon + 1); int p = 0; int n = after.length(); while (p < n) { int ch = (int)after.charAt(p); if (ch >= 48 && ch <= 57) break; p++; } int st = p; while (p < n) { int ch = (int)after.charAt(p); if (ch < 48 || ch > 57) break; p++; } if (p > st) { emit(Long.parseLong(after.substring(st, p))); }

scripted_metric.reduce_script: long min = Long.MAX_VALUE; boolean any = false; for (def s : states) { for (def t : s) { long tv = (long)t; if (tv < min) min = tv; any = true; } } return any ? Instant.ofEpochMilli(min).toString() : null;
Set out = new TreeSet(); for (def s : states) { out.addAll(s); } return new ArrayList(out);
